values: Enter one payment per row in the Payment Import sheet.
One petrol sale equals one row.
Use the drop-down fields where provided.
Fuel, app, status and shift must match a listed value.
Use a date and time for every payment.
For a successful payment it usually equals gross amount.
Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, Card, Cash
